rule: Projection is a structural copy only. It must never derive or promote values across layers.
transformation_rules: Only observation_records with a non-null key and value are projected.
Duplicate keys with different values are rejected.
Duplicate keys with the same value are allowed only if evidence refs are merged before projection.
No missing observation is synthesized as confirmed/failed.
No generic voice/SMS/data result is split into directional or internal states.
No 4G/5G/5G+ UI hint is promoted to registration/CA/DC.
No software version match is promoted beyond the recorded binding_state.
privacy_review must pass before a capture can be projected.
